hypotheses: Packed Q4/Q8 still requires row decoding after RAM residency
32KiB tiles cause large matrices to fail the per-tile dual-core threshold
Repeated PIE CSR switches for each 32-element dot
Many convolution channel tiles reload and underutilize a second core
changes: Verified resident matrix view with two private per-lane row scratch buffers
One parallel dispatch for whole packed matrix
Convolution tile admission up to 256KiB with allocation fallback
Group-scale validation hoisted out of per-element loop; direct immutable cache access
PIE mode scoped to compute body; interrupts enabled, original context save/selftest retained
limitations: Rows, lane math and per-op metrics are nested; do not add them to encoder/joiner times
Host wall speed is not P4 speed
Fixed two public samples are regressions, not a recognition accuracy evaluation
interpretation: Full residency removes weight I/O during inference. General graph execution and dense matrix/convolution arithmetic remain expensive. Larger work units now dispatch both CPU lanes; no weights, vocabulary, frame count or greedy decoder changes. New resident row preparation is included in lane_math, not the old rows counter.
